title: Markdown Viewer
summary: A local-first Markdown workspace, from the first draft to the shared document.
problem: Technical writing needs more than a preview: documents, diagrams, review and sharing should work together.
contribution: Created and maintain the editor, its document workspace, rendering workflows and web/desktop delivery.
features: Folders, tabs, IndexedDB autosave and encrypted workspace storage.
Rich rendering, anchored review comments and optional Live Share.
imageAlt: Markdown Viewer workspace showing its document explorer, editor and rendered preview.

title: MediChain
summary: Making a medicine's journey visible across a pharmaceutical supply chain.
problem: Medicine registration, inventory and purchase history need a shared record across supply-chain roles.
contribution: Led full-stack development in a four-person team, connecting the web interface with blockchain workflows.
features: Track medicine batches, lifecycle states and purchase history.
Connect role-based web interfaces to Ethereum contracts.
imageAlt: MediChain dashboard showing medicine stock and supply-chain records.

title: NoteMarker Extension
summary: Keep the useful parts of the web, right where you found them.
problem: Research gets fragmented when highlights and notes are separated from the pages that inspired them.
contribution: Built and maintain an open-source extension for highlighting webpages and creating persistent notes.
features: Persistent five-color highlights and rich-text sticky notes.
Move, resize and manage annotations on the original webpage.
imageAlt: NoteMarker highlights and sticky notes on a research paper webpage.
